author: Yffe
content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_vec_push_frame.rs::divergence_push_frames_prior_elements demonstrates the divergence. The emitted bounded-Vec push ens (emit_one_vec_wrapper, thermite-lower/src/lower.rs) is { well_formed; len'==len+1; data@[old_len]==x } and OMITS the element-preservation frame forall|j| 0<=j<old_len ==> final(self).data@[j]==old(self).data@[j]. The design's GROUNDED BVec seed (.design/basis/04-collections.md 'The verified Verus form (GROUNDED)') AND REQ-5 prose ('plus the element-preservation frame') both mandate it; the emitted pop_last DOES carry a kept-prefix frame, so push is the inconsistent one. Consequence: after a second push, a caller cannot prove get(0) is the first pushed element (borrow/by-value get ens *result==v@[i] is unframed across a later push). Real verus on the emitted wrapper + a 2-push value-pinning client: 9 verified, 1 errors (assertion failed on the first-element pin); WITH the design frame it is 4 verified, 0 errors (critic probe confirmed). Fix: re-add the forall|j| element frame to push's ensures in emit_one_vec_wrapper (+ the L1 mirror if applicable). R-DEFER-9: a design-stated obligation silently dropped.
